body.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE vertical painted adventure world-map terrain strip, 1024x1536, made of FOUR vertically stacked contiguous REGIONS, not a finished interface. Source image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for painterly Russian fairy-tale landscapes, realistic miniature wooden villages, birches, deep pine forests, antique gold sunset light, dark navy shadows and winding river geography. Render from consistent high three-quarter aerial map view, close enough that each region is a distinct dramatic landmark, NOT distant panoramic scenery. Entire image filled with terrain; no sky or horizon. EXACTLY FOUR equal-height regions, one per vertical quarter, each with a large readable centerpiece alternating left/right. Soft organic wooded boundaries between regions, NO hard card frames or horizontal rules. Continuous narrow winding earth road connects all four regions from TOP to BOTTOM. Four landmarks must remain inside their own quarter with foliage at top/bottom edges. Keep the lowest 20% of each quarter subdued and uncluttered for separately overlaid native chapter name. Rich but controlled detail, warm lanterns, restrained highlights, legible silhouettes at phone size. NO UI, text, lettering, numbers, labels, emblems, nodes, gold dotted lines, circles, lock icons, panels, portraits, hero characters, frames, borders, watermarks. Treat narrative only as location guidance, do not render story scenes or characters. Regions top to bottom:
ZONE 1, vertical band 0-25%: The Northern Lights. Theme: Magic of the North, alliance with frost. Story setting: The land of eternal winter and dancing auroras. Here live Father Frost (Морозко) and the Snow Maiden (Снегурочка). At first they are cold and distant — the fading of the Living Lights has made even frost spirits weaker and more irritable.
ZONE 2, vertical band 25-50%: Golden-Domed Moscow. Theme: National heart, unity, mid-game climax. Story setting: A mythical, fairy-tale version of Moscow with golden domes that shine even in the fading world. The three great bogatyrs — Ilya, Dobrynya, and Alyosha — gather here for the first time in ages. The city is under siege by shadow forces.
ZONE 3, vertical band 50-75%: Northern Venice. Theme: Beauty, elegance, deepening bonds. Story setting: A dream-like vision of St. Petersburg — canals of pure light, white nights that never end, palaces of ice and glass. The atmosphere is refined and slightly melancholic. Here the relationship with Vasilisa (or another companion) deepens through quiet conversations and shared levels under the endless twilight.
ZONE 4, vertical band 75-100%: Taurida / Crimea. Theme: Sun, ancient memory, rising tension. Story setting: Sunny shores, vineyards, and ruins of ancient cities. The light here is stronger, but so is the shadow that tries to corrupt it. The hero discovers an ancient prophecy carved in stone: the final battle will take place at the roots of the World Tree, and only one who has walked every land of Rus can open the way.
